content:
tara: quick thread 1 - NovaSI sent a marketplace packet that includes firmware, manifest, cert_chain.pem, soc2-excerpt.pdf, and a short pen-summary. Legal says cert chains cannot be published without redaction. we need a short playbook and presign flow.
lee-partner: can confirm. partner can provide signer cert to reviewers but wants minimal public footprint.
mina-sec: security rules: remove PEM blobs from public package, redact serial/hw_id/mac, deterministic placeholders (REDACTED-<8hex>), store raw evidence in KMS bucket, presign TTL=7d, gate presign behind an access request ticket.
sam-ops: ops checklist: 1) run redaction script 2) compute SHA256 of raw + redacted bundle 3) upload public assets 4) archive raw to s3://marketplace-evidence/novasi/ with CMK + MFA delete 5) create presign after ticket approval and log audit events.
frank-legal: legal wants a one-line listing note: "Sensitive device identifiers and cert material removed; full artifacts available to authorized reviewers under NDA." I'll finalize.
tara: small redaction examples to include in runbook so partners can pre-redact: jq to remove PEM and redact fields: ```bash
jq '.serial = "REDACTED" | .hw_id = "REDACTED" | del(.cert_chain)' manifest.json > manifest.public.json
```
mina-sec: deterministic placeholder python for runbook: ```python
import hashlib
def ph(v):
  return 'REDACTED-'+hashlib.sha256(v.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
```
sam-ops: presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/novasi/firmware.tar.gz --expires-in 604800` ; create ticket INF-9002 before generating.
access-bot: access-bot: created ticket INF-9002 and runbook stub: https://confluence.redwood.internal/marketplace/novasi-cert-playbook :ticket:
lee-partner: i'll send attestation PDF and reviewer contact once NDA is in place.
mina-sec: require that signer_cert (PEM) is only in restricted package and is delivered via presign. public listing must not contain PEM blocks. also store mapping of REDACTED placeholders in secure KV accessible to security and partner liaison only.
frank-legal: suggest add evidence-access addendum to NDA (one-page) and include required requester fields (name, org, purpose, approver).
tara: timeline: sam to run redaction and publish public bundle by EOD, lee to provide attestation + contact, mina to validate redaction, frank to post listing line. post presign link + SHA256 in this thread when ready.
sam-ops: on it 1 will post link and hashes here.
